notes.title: Poker Quest v62 - Major update! New hero, graphics, and more
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36191809/a1f38f243f5ff81fe78273aa6e9792debd52634b.png

* NEW HERO: The Rainbow Knight!
* Phoenix can be killed by Enflame once again.
* Corrected texts on some items (Holy Mace, Splendid Sword of Thunder, Splendid Axe of Flame, Dark Warhammer of Pairs) and Wildsmith.
* Multiple camping tents can now be used at a given node (including camp sites).
* Scroll of Greed can no longer be used without first having enough max life.
* Changed some items (particularly stashes) that had inconsistent enchant conditions.
* Bless should now work correctly with certain status effects (like Hex).
* Shieldbash should now deal the correct amount of damage when enflamed.
* Items with Lock should now refresh correctly after revival.
* Stunbolts will now correctly stun when next lightning is at 20%.
* Enchantment texts should now show the correct values during Sudden Death.
* World modifiers that cause specific cards to be drawn will no longer draw those cards if they are stashed.
* Increased the size of the preview cards for the Foresight mechanic.
* Gargoyle's Armor mechanics should now work properly.
* Explosive mechanics should now correctly deal Fire damage.
* Monsters that steal resources should no longer do so when enflame should have killed them first.
* Item Smash mechanics should now ignore consumables.
* Lightning should now be correctly be affected by the world modifier "Strong Attacks."
* Item bonuses should now work correctly with the "Slow Items" Challenge.
* Spirithorn should no longer cause unexpected deaths during the "Queen of Spades" world modifier.
* Multiple actions can no longer be bound to the same key (which could cause crashes).
* Fixed a crash related issue caused by Mixturedraw.
* Fixed a crash related issue involving the confirmation checkbox when applying status effects.
* Fixed some issues related to Achievements that caused some of them to be unachievable.
* Fixed an issue that prevented importing saves.
* Fixed a tutorial related bug.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36191809/feeab45372851034fe888be0de61c28450b69c70.png

notes.title: Poker Quest v57 - New victory conditions and major changes
notes.notes:
The game now has much more appropriate victory conditions. Everything after the World 1 boss is now optional. We believe this update will appeal to all of the players who want less of a challenge, while at the same time we hope the players who enjoy an epic challenge feel like they still get one. 

Please read the patch notes in detail to understand how these changes affect the game.

NEW FEATURE: Claim Victory & Raise The Stakes

 After each world, you now have the option to Claim Victory or Raise the Stakes.
 "Claim Victory" to end the run early, and get bonus Score & XP.
 Or "Raise the Stakes", and keep playing, which increases the bonus XP if you Claim Victory after the next boss fight.
 Getting through World 1 is "Victory", World 2 is "Victory+", and so on.
 We believe these new victory rankings more accurately represent the challenge involved in achieving them.
 Those of you who previously achieved the old "Victory" status have actually been achieving "Victory+++" without knowing it.


 IMPORTANT CHANGES TO WORLD 4:

 Due to overwhelming demand from players, we shortened the length of the complete game (assuming you always want to Raise the Stakes).
 The final boss is now at world 4-1, immediately after the campsite, which shortens the full game by about 25%.
 The rest of world 4 (after the final boss) is an optional series of boss fights that rapidly scale up.
 After each fight in World 4, you have the option to Claim Victory, or gamble on the next fight for a higher score.
 We removed the Palace of Wagers. To get higher scores, try to defeat as much of World 4 as you can.


OTHER CHANGES:

 The card deck finally has face card art!
 The Queen of Spades energy ability now draws all the Spades for 5 energy.
 Removed most of the "Nothing" nodes, they are replaced with small piles of food, chips, and gems.
 Wizard Tower and Gem Mines now only cost 1 chip to upgrade your maximum (instead of 3).
 Added a new Hero Select option to choose a random hero from the heroes you unlocked.
 New Classic, Daily, and Custom Run world modifier: Casino World. Worlds full of casinos!
 New Daily and Custom Run world modifier: Enchantress World. Worlds with way too many enchantresses.
 Scroll of Greed can no longer be used unless you have more than 50 maximum life.
 Reduced Wild Joker's life (relative to other Jokers) by 12%.
 The "No Modifiers" option now always shows up as an option in Classic mode.
 Count Spade and Vampire (monster) have been rebalanced. They have a new effect called "Restless".
 Sleight of Hand now costs 25 chips instead of 20
 Enchantresses now appear in Castles again, just not simultaneously with shops.
 All pets now scrap for 5 food.
 Changed the upgrade prices for Fire Gloves from 15/20/25 to 20/20/20.
 Book of Paralysis now has a limit of 3 uses per combat.
 Ring of More now costs 11 instead of 8.
 Challenge Runs now show 5 challenges instead of 3, to give you more choices.
 Fixed Vampire's energy tooltip. It now correctly says +2 energy per map move.
 Enflame/Freeze now show decay amounts on enemy items.
 Slightly tweaked the options for The Fool and Strange Device.
 New Loading Tips to help explain the game better.
 New, better looking Victory / Game Over / Mid-run status screens.
 We considered it, but the Mighty Titan is not changing (Sorry, Reto)
 Renamed the Ninja to "The Dodgy Ninja" to more accurately represent his play style.
 Several other minor bug and text fixes.

notes.title: Poker Quest v56 - Daily run bonus XP and Farm changes
notes.notes:
* IMPORTANT: The Daily Run is now called "Daily Bonus Run", and awards +150% XP.
* Increased the number of farms on all maps.
* Farms now cost 1 chip for 3 food instead of 5 chips for 5 food.
* Re-designed Bungling Burglar to make a bit more sense.
* Huntress's energy ability now costs 2 instead of 3.
* Enchantresses now very rarely appear in castles.
* Aegis items now have a limited number of uses per combat.
* Some new artwork.

notes.title: Poker Quest Alpha v48 is now live! Major update with lots of new stuff.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36191809/f536ecd774b8900ae3c708915935c31be67fe873.png

Lots of new stuff and big changes with this update! Thanks for playing and helping us get to this point! The game has came a long way since the initial demo release and now this will be the final update before the game launches in early access. 

* NEW FEATURE! CUSTOM RUNS. Design a run just the way you like it.

* NEW WORLD MODIFIER: "Impostor". Heroes will start with items from other heroes.

* NEW HERO: The Monk!

* IMPORTANT: Re-ordered the heroes in the Hero Select screen. You may notice some extra heroes unlocked.

* The Casual mode upgrade "Reveal X enemy cards every round" has been changed to "Reveal the first X cards each combat", and split into more upgrades.

* Added two new Catacombs: Dreadshield, Firewall

* Added empty nodes to the world map. There is nothing in these nodes.

* Rebalanced the monsters so they are a little bit easier than they used to be.

* Added "Previous Best" lines to the world map for each hero.

* Huntress's energy ability cost reduced from 3 to 2.

* Fixed a bug where Phoenix was invulnerable against Enflame

* Craven chef now reduced to 5 available food.

* When enemies take Curse damage, it now happens at the start of the next round, instead of at the end of their turn.

* Darksludge now removes curse when applying poison.

* Pierce damage now ignores Armor.

* Block now blocks damage before Armor.

* Counterattack now works with Armor.

* Rebalanced Soulseeker.

* Vampire is no longer affected by the "Lose less life from starving" casual upgrade.

* There is now a maximum of 999 chips. Any amount higher will be discarded.

* Phoenix is no longer impossible to kill with Enflame.

* Blessed items now deal their damage after the item effects take place.

* Illumination now works when enemy items are disabled.

* Added hotkeys for Casinos.

notes.title: Biggest update in months! Poker Quest Version 42 alpha is up!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36191809/1a03898eeb009c6d8e5dce284fef5199d3c1f6fb.png

Poker Quest v42 (Feb. 2, 2020):

 NEW ANIMATED EFFECTS! In the Steam version, there are new animated combat effects for attacks, enflame, curse, etc.
 NEW HERO: The Ninja!
 NEW GUILD SKILL: "Alchemy". It allows you to re-fill an additional consumable item at campsites.
 NEW ENHANCEMENT RELIGIONS: Faces, Reds, Blacks, Odds, and Evens.
  See the complete patch notes in the game.
